objective: Diagnostico aislado READ_ONLY de la consulta PERMS del Gate3B Custodia. No DDL/DML, no cambios de repositorio, no Produccion.

queries.name: perms
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login, SUSER_SNAME() AS effective_login, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE TABLE') AS can_create_table, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo','SCHEMA','ALTER') AS can_alter_dbo, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','VIEW DEFINITION') AS can_view_definition;
